method: EEGNet-8,2 fixed prospective control; original ARL Keras architecture

source.license: Upstream CC0 with patent grant and Apache2 notices retained verbatim in ordinary LICENSE.txt

architecture.input: batch, complete ordered channels, full resampled epoch time, singleton channel-last feature
architecture.classes: Fixed semantic dataset K; no binary four-logit convention for this prospective control

input_adaptation.reason: ARL source explicitly defines the architecture for128Hz. Use one fixed deterministic method-local rational resampling to its documented rate; preserve complete supplied epochs and original row/channel order.
input_adaptation.source_rate: Exact rational from public row sampling_hz; no data/header inference
input_adaptation.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly with reduced positive integer up/down, window=('kaiser',5.0), padtype='constant', no trim/pad/crop after full transform
input_adaptation.output_samples: ceil(original_samples*up/down), common complete source epoch shape within the selected episode
input_adaptation.units: Physical mV using exact declared V:1000,mV:1,uV/µV/μV:0.001; unknown units refused. This is fixed physical scaling, not fit normalization.
input_adaptation.channels: All original supplied channel IDs retained in order; no requested channel discarded or invented.
input_adaptation.input_type: finite float32, no learned preprocessing/query fit
input_adaptation.qualification: Resampler/environment and source numerical equivalence remain external native qualification; source policy is explicitly prospective, not an EEGPT-paper EEGNet run.

training.loss: Sparse categorical crossentropy on semantic labels, mathematically equivalent to original one-hot categorical crossentropy; model returns K-column softmax
training.schedule: fixed constant learning rate; shuffle training rows using request-declared RNG; no omitted remainder batch
training.basis: ARL example uses Adam,categorical crossentropy,batch16,300epochs. The benchmark fixes this competent single recipe before exposure; it does not claim optimal hyperparameters.
training.selection: Actual full validation monitor specified by existing benchmark per dataset after every epoch; earliest strict best finite epoch. All epoch metrics/model artifacts retained; no query labels or global fold pooling.
training.state: Original .keras model checkpoints including optimizer state; actual parameter census and fixed source/adapter identities; same selected checkpoint loaded under trusted reference source only.
training.prediction: Exact selected model on full ordered query; no adaptation or refit; semantic probability columns0..K-1.
